europe_now.title: EU response to Ceuta migrant surge
europe_now.summary: On August 3, 2026, BBC News Europe reported that the EU called for stronger borders following increased migrant crossings at Ceuta. The announcement underscores growing security and political concerns over migration flows into Europe.

sources.headline: EU calls for stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings

europe_now.title: Danube drought threatens nuclear power in Hungary and Romania
europe_now.summary: On August 3, 2026, Deutsche Welle reported that low Danube River levels are threatening cooling systems for nuclear plants in Hungary and Romania. The situation highlights vulnerabilities in regional energy infrastructure amid ongoing drought.

sources.headline: Dry Danube River threatens nuclear power in Romania, Hungary

top_stories.title: EU ministers back Spain amid Ceuta migration rise
top_stories.summary: On August 3, 2026, POLITICO Europe reported that EU ministers announced support for Spain in response to rising migrant arrivals at Ceuta. The development reflects the issue's increased prominence on the EU's political agenda.

sources.headline: EU ministers to back Spain as Ceuta crisis pushes migration up the agenda

top_stories.title: Record heat drives wildfires and drought across western Europe
top_stories.summary: On August 3, 2026, France 24 English reported that record-breaking heat across Europe triggered wildfires and drought conditions in France, Greece, and the United Kingdom. The report links the extreme temperatures to heightened fire risk and water shortages.

sources.headline: Europe's record-breaking heat sparks wildfires, drought in France, Greece and the UK
